title: bell: the popover header counts 1 notification while its one grouped row says 3 unread, so the two counts disagree
body:
domain:ui#4 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbDAucNyQ4UtzCJKyh

Filing gate: ① a user-visible inconsistency with a named location. Split out of #27520 row 13, which falls in seat 4's area (notifications). Observed by the 18.3.0 RC walkthrough at `c4c515ad`. Mechanism read at `origin/main` `a75ddba1`. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Business reason

Who: every console user who opens the bell. What happens: with three unread notifications about one topic and three pending approvals, the header reads `4 total · 1 notification + 3 pending approvals`, but the single collapsed row reads `×3 … 3 unread` and shows only the first record's text. The reader cannot tell whether one thing or three are waiting.

## Mechanism

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/InboxPopover.tsx` ~L182–185: the header and the badge count unread **topics** (`unreadTopics`, one per `groupNotifications` group with any unread row), plus pending approvals.
- The grouped row draws its own `groupUnread` (`{{count}} unread`, en.ts ~L4172), which counts unread **rows**.
- Both numbers are correct readings of different units. Nothing on screen names the unit.

## Wanted

The header breakdown and the grouped row read as one story: either name the unit (topics against messages), or count the same unit in both places. Whether a grouped row expands to list its records is part of the same row. `toggleGroup` exists in the popover, so measure first whether that already works.

## Dedupe

I read the 266 most recent issues by title for `bell`, `notification count` and `unread`. #27626 polls the same bell, but it is a performance issue. #27447 (closed) covered mark-read on Home. **New.**

Links back: #27520 (row 13)
